pattern.description: The signal-detail UI tilts back in 3D perspective and recedes, revealing the service map. The map then eases into a slow pull-out centred on the red web-store node. The fixed caption pill swaps to the next line of copy and resizes to fit it.
pattern.why_premium: The 3D tilt makes the scene change feel spatial, as if moving between layers of one product, instead of a flat cut. The fixed caption carries the sentence across scenes, so the copy reads as one continuous thought.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(panel, {rotationX: 30, rotationY: -20, scale: 0.8, opacity: 0, transformPerspective: 1200, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.in'}).fromTo(map, {scale: 1.06}, {scale: 1, duration: 1.2, ease: 'power2.out'}, '-=0.1'); caption: tl.set(caption, {textContent: next}) at the swap, then animate the pill width with a 0.2 s 'power2.out' tween.
build_hint.remotion: For the outgoing panel, interpolate rotateX/rotateY/scale/opacity with Easing.in(Easing.quad) inside a perspective(1200px) wrapper. For the map, scale 1.06 to 1 using spring({damping: 200, stiffness: 60}) (slow, no overshoot). Switch the caption text on a frame threshold.

notes: The outgoing panel is not on the end frame, so it has no box. The web-store tooltip (b04/b07/b16/b17/b20) is already visible at f1291 and only moves with the map, so it is not listed. Code verdict is camera pull_out (scale 0.94). Every SFX candidate sits on a regular music percussion grid, so none could be confirmed as an edit SFX.
